name: Awesome iOS DESIGN.md
summary: 200 DESIGN.md packs that document the design systems of popular mobile apps, in four framework flavors.
description: Reverse-engineered design systems for 200 apps, organized in 11 categories (social, messaging, travel, music, video, food, finance, fitness, productivity, dating, misc). Each app folder ships four markdown versions — framework-neutral plus SwiftUI, Expo/React Native and Jetpack Compose — covering palettes, type ramps, component states, grids, motion curves and haptics. Files follow the Stitch DESIGN.md format read by Claude, Cursor, Codex and Google Stitch.
